scope_notes: Steps 2-7 (thumbnail persistence, pipeline, CDN config, signed URL routing) were already implemented in 23870cd24 (feat(images)) and merged into main before this session started. The plan fingerprint approved those surface decisions and this Code Generation run verified the baseline at Step 1.

The original plan referenced a previous commit's `cover_image_key` design. That field is the existing gallery-cover selection (unchanged); the new column added by the merged commit is `thumbnail_image_key` (nullable, private 600x600 derivative). Step 2 confirms the approved persistence boundary is `thumbnail_image_key` per the merged commit.
